incumbent.text: Hypothesis: server startup registers only a unary interceptor chain, so per-stream interceptors are absent and the streaming listing RPC bypasses the authenticator. Prerequisites: preshared-credential service, one seeded tuple, and the ability to call both RPCs without metadata. Bounded test: compare a missing-credential unary listing call with a missing-credential streaming call, recording status and returned identifiers. Expected supporting result: unary is rejected while streaming returns the seeded identifier. Falsifier: both calls are rejected or both are accepted. Cleanup: stop the service and delete the seeded store.

hint: The baseline asymmetry is known: without a credential the unary listing RPC is rejected while the streaming listing RPC returns a seeded object. A repair is now needed. Which minimal wiring change installs the existing authenticator for streams, does the streaming handler also need the server stream context rather than a fresh background context, and what local matrix distinguishes a complete repair from an auth-only change?
